title: Onboarding landing: slim hero pathway visuals & modular step screenshots
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Scope: Refresh the quickstart landing hero and supporting step diagrams to a slim, modular visual language that reduces vertical real estate and improves scanability on desktop and mobile. Deliverables: (1) Hero variants (desktop wide, tablet, mobile compact) with progressive-reveal micro-animations; (2) A set of 5 modular step card templates with live-data screenshot slots; (3) Hand-off-ready Figma file with tokens, export slices, and developer notes; (4) Screenshot capture runbook and final asset export package for marketing and docs. Goals: increase click-through to quickstart by 18% in experiments, reduce hero height by ~30% on landing while keeping clarity of product value, and lower cognitive load for new users by surfacing 3 primary starter paths (API, Dedicated, Private).
